dishes.name: Shrimp croquette
dishes.desc: Crisp-fried croquette filled with creamy grey North Sea shrimp. A fixture of Flemish coast and Bruges restaurant menus.

dishes.name: Eel in green sauce
dishes.desc: Eel stewed in a sauce of fresh green herbs, a Flemish dish from the coast and rivers of West Flanders. Served with fries or bread.

dishes.name: Mussels with fries
dishes.desc: Steamed mussels in celery and onion broth served with a bowl of fries. Belgium's best-known meal, eaten along the coast and in Bruges from late summer.

dishes.name: Ostend sole
dishes.desc: Dover sole from the Ostend fleet, pan-fried in butter and served whole with potatoes. The classic dish of the Flemish coast.

dishes.name: Bruges chocolates
dishes.desc: Hand-made chocolates and pralines, many shaped as swans or lace patterns, sold in the centre's small chocolate workshops.
